look_here_first: Start with the bark and fruiting heads. American sycamore has dramatically exfoliating mottled bark that exposes chalky white to pale tan patches, huge alternate palmately lobed leaves, and round hanging fruiting balls made of many achenes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: mottled exfoliating bark with white/tan upper trunk patches

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: very large alternate palmately lobed leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: petiole base encloses the axillary bud

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: spherical flower/fruit heads on long peduncles

lookalikes.differences: Mottled exfoliating bark + giant alternate lobed leaves + spherical hanging fruit heads is the core field package.
